list.title: 🚨 The DARK SECRET of the tax office in Germany: money to your parents in India = up to €1,297 back per parent
items: 🇮🇳 Parents have little or no income

📅 Pay regularly – months don't count back

blocks: Send it to someone who supports parents in India
